purpose: Attack the polynomial-envelope route with a structured non-affine proof-complexity family instead of only random one-swap residuals, while retaining an affine Tseitin negative control.

literature_provenance.family: standard nondeterministic 3-CNF extension of the pigeonhole principle EPH_n^{n+1}
literature_provenance.source: Albert Atserias and Victor Dalmau, A Combinatorial Characterization of Resolution Width, ECCC TR02-035, Section 5
literature_provenance.source_formula: EP_i = not y_i,0 AND_j (y_i,j-1 OR p_i,j OR not y_i,j) AND y_i,n; plus all collision clauses (not p_i,k OR not p_j,k) for distinct pigeons i,j and each hole k
literature_provenance.role: structured non-affine adversarial intake; no claim that a lower bound for bare resolution automatically transfers to TRUMP

frozen_php_family.variable_order: all p_i,j in lexicographic (i,j), followed by all y_i,j in lexicographic (i,j)
frozen_php_family.stop_rule: scan n ascending and stop at the first formula whose existing R47M full normalization reaches a certified nonterminal joint fixpoint; if none, exhaust n=2..7

negative_control.family: existing R33 cubic prism Tseitin contradictions
negative_control.required: R34 recognizes complete affine CNF and returns independently verified AFFINE_XOR_UNSAT

frozen_existing_stack: R33 -> affine recognition/GF2 terminal -> RUP vivification -> SA-BVE, restarted to the existing R47M certified joint fixpoint
measurements: R47M terminal or nonterminal joint-fixpoint status
normalization segment count and SA-BVE count
if nonterminal: residual hash, CLV, affine-recognition reason, RUP replay, and BVE absence
